product_metadata.title: MoKo Vanity Tray, Resin Three-Compartment Jewelry Dish Tray Bathroom Countertop Organizer Catchall Tray for Bathroom Bath Tub Countertop Jewelries Vanity Organization - Sandy White
features: 🍒【Countertop Organizer】: According to your different needs, this tray can be used as a jewelry tray or bathroom tray, suitable for toilet tank, wash basin, bathroom, vanity countertop, linen closet, bedside table, or any other places you want.

🍒【Three Compartment Design】: The three-compartment design makes it more convenient for you to keep you items classified and organized. Perfect for neatly arranging your jewelry like earrings, rings, bracelets, necklaces, hairband, perfume, etc.
🍒【Sturdy and Durable】: Made of premium resin material, this resin tray is waterproof, anti-scratch and easy to clean. (NOTE: Please clean with damp cloth or water.)
🍒【Perfect Size for Vanity Organization】: 25.5*17*3 cm / 10.04*6.69*1.18 inch. Perfect size for neatly arranging your items without taking too much space.
🍒【Elegant Design】: Comes with imitated marble texture, the tray creates the exquisite appearance and graceful style. It can match various kinds of rom decorations and be a nice decorative addition.
